decisions.reason: The low-noise burner is a component that strengthens the core infrared heater range, so keeping it costs little, and with no evidence after 2019 there is no signal that would justify abandoning it.

The plaque heater has its own page and sits at the centre of the firm's narrow infrared range, so it is a cheap option worth keeping while demand for energy-efficient heating stays uncertain but favourable.
The luminous radiant heater fits the established hall-heating offer with low carrying cost, and no results show its value is unlikely to be realized.
This tube heater line with several models is a core product family for industrial halls, and keeping it preserves options on the individual models at little extra cost.
The standard plaque heater is a basic volume product on its own page, and there is no evidence of failure that would justify dropping it.
This tube heater may overlap with line D and could be consolidated, but the uncertainty remains unresolved and keeping it costs little, so the option stays open.
